skill.summary: Moderna pioneers mRNA technology, with a platform for vaccines and therapies including COVID-19, cancer, rare diseases, and infectious diseases.

latestVersion.changelog:
- 首次发布Moderna专题技能，聚焦其mRNA技术创新和商业化历程
